pages.text: $(t3)Tier 3$(end) bosses are the most varied in the pack. Meet Your Fight superbosses, Cataclysm ultra-bosses, vanilla Wither and Warden, and the Botania Gaia Guardian all live here. Full diamond gear is the minimum. Terrasteel or Enderium recommended.

$(bold)Meet Your Fight$(/bold) — 4 superbosses in specialized biomes:$(br)Swampjaw → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Harbinger$(/l) (18%)$(br)Bellringer → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Hearthflame$(/l) (18%)$(br)Dame Fortuna → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiscythe$(/l) (18%)$(br)Rosalyne → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magispear$(/l) (18%)$(br2)$(bold)Wither$(/bold) — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulkeeper$(/l) (15%), Wither Bone, Ancient Debris peek.

$(bold)Cataclysm Bosses$(/bold)$(br)Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The Harbinger, The Leviathan, Maledictus — 5 ultra-bosses in massive Cataclysm structures. Each drops a unique weapon and boss material. The hardest $(t3)T3$(end) content.$(br2)$(bold)Warden$(/bold) (Vanilla)$(br)Deep Dark. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Stormbringer$(/l) (20%).$(br2)$(bold)Botania Gaia Guardian$(/bold) — Summoned. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiblade$(/l) (20%), Gaia Spirit Fragment. Scales progressively.
